checks_run.procedure: Source review of operating rules against the playbook and master prompt, unchanged since round 1 and re-checked on this candidate: the T10 area rules, escalation once to the next authority, the closure guard, BAU acceptance, change-request preservation, the Modular G3 waiver (D-110, ADR-0021 W1-W7), and the register partial disclosures. checks_run.expected: Rules match their sources, and the partial disclosures are honest and acceptable.
checks_run.actual: T10 RAG comes from the KPI trajectory and the validated-value gap, never from completion (B0095). Forecast, submitted and scenario values are never counted as validated. Finance validation is FIN-only with SoD, and the amendment and reversal chain is preserved (now version-stepped). Escalation goes once to the next authority, with routing errors visible. Closure is refused while value is pending unless a transition decision exists. BAU acceptance is by the receiving owner only and creates the recurring reviews once. G5 requires risk closure and a scale scope, and scaling outside that scope is refused. G6 requires ownership transfer. The Modular waiver covers missing links only and is refused when revoked or expired. All of these are exercised by the green acceptance suites (A03-A14) in DOM-R2-03. QA-C O-2: a transformation stays 'draft' until explicit activation while G1-G6 progress (dom-api STATUS observation: status=draft, phase=diagnose). The playbook defines phases and gates, not a record lifecycle, so this does not contradict the source; the phase and gate state carry the progression. Acceptable. QA-B: deciding a Draft gate answers 409 gate.submission_superseded ('There is no pending submission to decide') and writes nothing. REQ-S04-010 requires only rejection, and the decideGate contract defines 409. This is DG2-approved behaviour, which I accept as an observation. Register partials (PB-065, PB-066, PB-075, S04-014, S07-005, S07-007, S07-015, S08-015, S13-003, S15-008, S20-011): each is plainly disclosed and each clause is proven by an executed test on the same engine. summary: FAIL. Both of my round-1 findings verify CLOSED_VERIFIED on candidate 3f51b79d (1455 files, recomputed on a complete clone of 93a7dd7). F-DG4-121: gross and net are 90, not 435, with revenue uplift and avoided cost shown beside gross and labelled in EN/AR. The D-117 rule fits M0172 and B0145. F-DG4-120: the Arabic T11 page shows the provisional notice, and the English labels are marked lang=en. The build, lint and typecheck are clean on Node 22 and 24, and the unit tests give 2782 passed plus 259 passed and 2 skipped by design. The integration project ran 1957 tests: all 1953 candidate tests pass, including every acceptance suite. The one failure was my own stale probe, which passed after I corrected it and re-ran it alone. The source fidelity probes pass: API 49/49, UI 38/38, gross probe 14/14. Three new findings make this round FAIL. F-DG4-122 (High, mandatory): the 'Value gap' ratio is rendered as a SAR amount ('SAR 1.00' for 100 %) on T10, the Executive Overview and the Finance dashboard, in EN and AR. F-DG4-123 (Medium): the five-class 'Planned value'/'Validated value' headlines still add revenue to margin and avoided cost to cash (435 beside a gross of 90), against M0172. F-DG4-124 (Medium, owner orchestrator): stages.json at the freeze commit records REVIEWING -> REVIEWING, so the mandated --historical validators fail at HEAD; they pass at 93a7dd7. Judged and acceptable: QA-C O-2, QA-B's 409, the register partial disclosures, and the DG3 business-case totals (a per-basis breakdown with a revenue-and-margin warning).
